title: Hauled to Hearth
description: Hauled to Hearth is a custom mod that replaces harsh death screens with a cozy extraction. When health hits zero, players are safely whisked to their bed with atmospheric sounds, mystical particles, and a warm, guiding message from The Elder Hearth.
body: "Hauled to Hearth" is a mechanic designed to replace the standard, harsh death screen with something more immersive and restorative. When a player's health hits zero, the mod steps in to intercept the event. Instead of a traditional respawn, the player is whisked away in a cinematic "blackout" sequence, set to atmospheric woodland sounds. They wake up safely back home—a sanctuary marked by lingering, mystical particles—while a calming message from "The Elder Hearth" appears in chat to signal their safe arrival. By balancing this rescue with a minor, non-destructive experience penalty, the mod turns failure into a cozy, atmospheric part of the world-building, keeping the game stress-free and cohesive for the whole family.
